title: SCRIPT_ROUTING_COMPLIANCE_CHECK
description: Agent self-check output before finalizing script_routing.json. Must be produced by the Agent for every SCRIPT_ROUTING_UNIT execution.

all_scripts_in_allowed_dir.description: True if EVERY step.script starts with 'scripts/'

no_demo_scripts.description: True if NO step.script starts with 'demo/', 'examples/', 'tests/', or 'src/'

all_scripts_exist.description: True if EVERY referenced script file exists on disk

violations.description: Empty array if no violations. Otherwise list each violation with step index and reason.

all_names_in_whitelist.description: True if EVERY step.name is in Allowed Step Types

allowed_step_types.description: Must exactly match: [prepare_dataset, materialize_templates, validate_execution_shell, wait_for_predictions, validate_predictions, evaluate_predictions]

overall_passed.description: True ONLY if script_constraints AND step_type_constraints both passed with zero violations

self_inspection_passed.description: Must equal compliance_check.overall_passed. If false, Agent MUST NOT produce script_routing.json and MUST report blocking_issues instead.

blocking_issues.description: Required when self_inspection_passed is false. Describes why compliance failed.

next_action.description: If passed: 'Proceed to output script_routing.json'. If failed: 'Fix violations before proceeding'.
